sections.markdown:
## E — Market signal: the four-part driver examination
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (MO-EXAM-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.
Guide-only observation, not market evidence: the separate road sign test and the graded driving maneuvers suggest learners want both a sign-recognition drill and a driving-test checklist, not only written-test questions.
No market figures are asserted; every figure waits for a sourced recon pass.

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: Missouri learner demand, pass rates, pricing, voice-of-customer quotes and ad hooks for the the four-part driver examination topic are unresearched.
